pages.text: $(bold)Idle Transfiguration$(): reshape the very shape of the soul. $(br2)Whenever you $(bold)kill$() a creature, that creature is $(bold)recorded$() into your form library. $(br2)$(bold)P key$(): open the $(bold)form selection screen$() (choose a recorded creature's form). $(br2)$(bold)Technique key C$(): $(li)with a form selected → $(bold)forward activation$(): you transfigure yourself into that creature (inheriting all of its base stats but not its abilities/AI)$(li)press again while transformed → $(bold)return to human form$()$(br2)$(bold)Technique reversal key F$(): toggle $(bold)Transfiguration Emission$() on / off. $(br2)$(bold)Transfiguration Emission$(): while on, your $(bold)next attack$() (no longer requiring line-of-sight locking) will transfigure whatever it hits into the selected creature: $(li)$(bold)creature target$() → $(bold)permanently transfigured$() and turned into your guardian shikigami (follows / protects / melee-attacks; $(bold)death is true death$() — it will not revert)$(li)$(bold)player target$() → reverts automatically after $(bold)60 seconds$(); during that time they cannot use tools$(li)the transfiguration fails if the target's health is too high or your Cursed Energy is insufficient$(br2)$(bold)Transfiguration traits$(): $(li)inherits the creature's $(bold)full base stats$() (health / speed / attack, etc.)$(li)does $(bold)not inherit$() its abilities or AI$(li)the transformed state is kept across logout and reverts automatically when you next log in$(li)occupies a technique slot.
